bio: Fried chicken in Nashville is far from a stretch, but SS Gai deals in Thai street-style fried chicken for an unexpected twist. Located in a refurbished car wash with vendors in the former bays, this spot has a one-track mind. It's all about Thai-style chicken, and while fried is the signature, it also comes grilled. Order at the window and select two or four pieces of gai tod that's impossibly crispy and bursting with flavor. It all comes with sticky rice and tamarind chili fish sauce for a hearty meal that shows off quality ingredients and hits all the right notes. From there, you can add in one of their pounded salads like the charred eggplant, but the mango crispy sticky rice slathered in a mango sauce with lime zest for dessert is essential....
